Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka will be slightly disappointed. This is a competitive target but would have hopes for more as their batters were in-form. There were losing wickets regularly. Pathum Nissanka handled one end quite well but was looking for support. When Charith Asalanka joined him in the middle, Sri Lanka were all set for a score around 280 but they lost wickets in leaps and the lower order failed to contribute. Now then! This is still a good score. Sri Lanka can defend this knowing their bowlers have been brilliant. Will Wanindu Hasaranga step up again? We will find out after the break.

A really good bowling performance by Scotland. They will be very happy with this score. There were moments when Scotland were off the target but they did well to take wickets at regular intervals. The seamers controlled it for a long time but once the ball started to grip and stayed low, Greaves and Watt were unstoppable. The former took four wickets while the latter ended with three.
OUT! GONE! A full toss, outside off. Kumara tries to clear long off but fails to power and Chris Sole there takes it with ease. Chris Greaves ends with four. Sri Lanka are bowled out for 245.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. Time for the national anthems. It will be Scotland's first followed by of the Lankans. Time for action now. Pathum Nissanka and Dimuth Karunaratne are the openers for the Lankans. Chris Sole to bowl first.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Dimuth Karunaratne, Kusal Mendis (WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Maheesh Theekshana, Kasun Rajitha, Lahiru Kumara.

Scotland (Playing XI) - Christopher McBride, Matthew Cross (WK), Brandon McMullen, Richie Berrington (C), Tomas Mackintosh, Michael Leask, Chris Greaves, Mark Watt, Chris Sole, Jack Jarvis, Alasdair Evans.
Dasun Shanaka says they would have bowled first but are happy to bat. Adds they need to continue the good work and focus on their basics. Informs they are playing the same team.

Richie Berrington says they will bowl first and look for some early movement and execute their plans with the ball. Adds they know the importance of every game, the Lankans are really good but they are focusing on themselves. Informs there are two changes.
TOSS - Scotland have won the toss and will BOWL first!

It is time for yet another match in the Qualifiers. Welcome to the coverage of the match between Scotland and the Lankans. The spots have been filled for the super sixes and both these teams have done well to proceed further. Sri Lanka have been one of the best teams to feature and so are Scotland who are just like their opposition unbeaten. Scotland have exceeded their expectations but they face a tough task against the Lankans who have shown their class till now. Not much playing on this match but still a lot of excitement coming up for sure. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.
...MATCH DAY...

Two of the best teams of the ICC Cricket World Cup Qualifiers 2023 face off each other as Sri Lanka takes on Scotland in match no. 19 as Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo hosts this thrilling encounter. Sri Lanka and Scotland are the two unbeaten sides and this game will decide who walks in the super six unbeaten and with a full stack of points under their belt. Sri Lanka has blown apart all the teams they have played so far while Scotland have managed to win with different performers in different games. The form of Wanindu Hasaranga has been nothing but sensational as he has shown the quality he possesses. Dimuth Karunaratne and Pathum Nissanka have been giving the Islanders a solid start since their first game. For Scotland, the revival of Richie Berrington has been something to acknowledge along with the arrival of young all-rounder Brandon McMullen. Michael Leask has batted well and finished off games. Chris Greaves picked up a fifer in the last game and the team is clicking well in all the positions with match-winners throughout the side. The battle between these two strong sides would be nothing less than exciting. Expect a cracker of a game.
